sources.entry: Peon | Open-source self-hostable Docker PaaS. Deploy Git apps, Compose stacks, databases, and static sites

summary.one_liner: Peon is an open-source, self-hostable deployment platform (a Docker PaaS) for deploying Git apps, Docker Compose stacks, databases, and static sites to servers you own.
summary.what_it_does: Peon deploys apps from Git or Docker images to Linux servers over SSH, and the README names Hetzner, DigitalOcean, or bare metal as target infrastructure. It offers one-click service templates for databases, Compose stacks, and similar services. Workspaces and projects provide multi-user tenancy with role-based access. A background worker consumes SQS jobs for deployments, backups, and async tasks, while a separate cron scheduler enqueues recurring jobs. A terminal WebSocket server is included. The stack needs Node.js with pnpm, PostgreSQL, and either AWS SQS or a local ElasticMQ instance, with SES and S3 optional for email and asset storage.
use_cases: deploy git repositories to my own servers
run docker compose stacks on a VPS
provision one-click databases on my own infrastructure
host static sites on my own servers
manage deployments for a small team with role-based access
how_to_run: git clone the repository and cd into Peon
cp .env.example .env and set DATABASE_URL, JWT_SECRET, ENCRYPTION_KEY, and SQS URLs
docker compose --profile db --profile sqs up -d (optional local Postgres and ElasticMQ)
pnpm dev, plus pnpm worker, pnpm schedule, and pnpm socket in separate processes
notable: Git push deploys with TLS, backups, logs, and team workspaces on your own infrastructure
Local ElasticMQ option means no AWS account is needed for the queue
Separate worker, scheduler, and terminal socket processes that scale independently
Includes a deploy.sh script to promote staging to main and a release script that generates AI release notes
caveats: Requires several moving parts: Node, PostgreSQL, a queue, and a Linux server reachable over SSH to exercise real deployments
The scheduler must run as exactly one instance
Email and object storage features need SES and S3 credentials
keywords: deploy git apps to my server
